subject: ss-gastroenterology
title: Gastric neoplasms: Lauren types, hereditary diffuse cancer, GIST and neuroendocrine tumours

steps.tx: The **Lauren classification** splits gastric adenocarcinoma into two patterns examiners contrast. Intestinal type forms glands, follows Helicobacter and intestinal metaplasia, and is the one that can be polypoid. Diffuse type infiltrates as discohesive **signet-ring cells** and is linked to **CDH1**. The photo shows a dense infiltrate under the mucosal glands, which is the diffuse pattern, not a polyp sitting on normal wall.
steps.say: Lauren classification separates intestinal-type glands from diffuse signet-ring cells. Intestinal type follows Helicobacter and metaplasia. Diffuse type infiltrates under the mucosa and is the pattern linked to CDH1. The image is that diffuse infiltrate.

vis.alt: Gastric mucosa with glands above a dense diffuse cellular infiltrate in the wall.
vis.caption: Diffuse gastric carcinoma pattern under the mucosal glands. Image: Nephron, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons.

steps.tx: **Hereditary diffuse gastric cancer** is autosomal dominant. Germline inactivating **CDH1 mutations** remove E-cadherin, so signet-ring cells spread while the gastroscopy still looks nearly normal. Prophylactic total gastrectomy is the management once the pathogenic variant is confirmed, because biopsies miss the cells. First-degree relatives need genetic advice. A partial gastrectomy leaves stomach behind and is not the prophylactic operation.
steps.say: Hereditary diffuse gastric cancer comes from germline CDH1 mutations that inactivate E-cadherin. The mucosa can look normal while signet-ring cells are already there. Prophylactic total gastrectomy is the operation. A partial gastrectomy is not enough.

steps.tx: **Gastrointestinal stromal tumours** arise from the **interstitial cells of Cajal**. **CD117**, also called KIT, is expressed in over **95%**, and DOG1 is the backup stain when KIT is weak. Activating mutations sit in KIT or PDGFRA. The drawing shows several tumours in stomach and small bowel plus a KIT stain, which is the familial pattern. A solitary gastric GIST is the sporadic form of the same cell.
steps.say: Gastrointestinal stromal tumours come from interstitial cells of Cajal. CD117, or KIT, stains over 95 percent, and DOG1 helps when KIT is faint. Mutations are in KIT or PDGFRA. Multiple tumours suggest a familial pattern. A single gastric mass is the sporadic form.

vis.alt: Several GISTs in stomach and small bowel, pacemaker cells in the wall, and a brown KIT stain.
vis.caption: Multiple GISTs with interstitial cells of Cajal and a KIT stain. StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Imatinib mesylate** is the selective **tyrosine kinase inhibitor** that changed GIST from a surgery-only disease. It is frontline treatment for unresectable or metastatic disease, and it is given after resection when the recurrence risk is high. Mutation testing still matters, because some PDGFRA variants respond poorly. It is not chemotherapy in the FLOT sense, and it is not the drug for ordinary gastric adenocarcinoma.
steps.say: Imatinib mesylate is the tyrosine kinase inhibitor used first for unresectable, metastatic, or high-risk resected GIST. Some PDGFRA mutations are poorly responsive, and genotype testing is still required. It is not the regimen used for ordinary gastric adenocarcinoma.

steps.tx: **Gastric neuroendocrine tumours** come in three types. **Type 1 gastric NET** follows autoimmune atrophic gastritis and high gastrin, and it behaves in a benign way. Type 2 sits with Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and MEN1. Type 3 is sporadic, solitary and aggressive. Type 1 and type 2 are the gastrin-driven pair. Type 3 is the one you do not watch.
steps.say: Gastric neuroendocrine tumours are split into three types. Type 1 gastric NET follows autoimmune gastritis and high gastrin and is usually indolent. Type 2 comes with Zollinger-Ellison syndrome and MEN1. Type 3 is sporadic, solitary and aggressive.

steps.tx: **Linitis plastica** is diffuse scirrhous carcinoma. Fibrous desmoplasia in the submucosa and muscularis propria turns the stomach into a rigid **leather bottle** that will not distend. Endoscopy can miss it because the mucosa is intact over the tumour. A barium study or a CT that shows a narrow undistent stomach is the clue. Prognosis is poor, and the operation, when it is possible, is total gastrectomy rather than a sleeve.
steps.say: Linitis plastica is a leather bottle stomach. Desmoplasia in the submucosa and muscle stops the stomach distending, often under an intact mucosa. Endoscopy alone can miss it. When surgery is possible it is a total gastrectomy.

right.title: Looks like a polyp or ulcer

steps.tx: **Endoscopic submucosal dissection** for **early gastric cancer** is for **mucosal differentiated** adenocarcinoma. Without ulceration, size does not by itself forbid resection. If the lesion is ulcerated, it must be differentiated, **3 cm** or smaller, and free of lymphovascular invasion. Deeper submucosal cancer, poor differentiation with ulceration, or invaded vessels leaves the endoscopic option. Confirm the lift and the margins. This is not the operation for linitis plastica.
steps.say: Endoscopic resection of early gastric cancer is for mucosal differentiated adenocarcinoma. Without ulceration, size alone does not bar it. An ulcerated differentiated lesion must be 3 cm or smaller and free of lymphovascular invasion. Linitis plastica is not an endoscopic target.

nodes.label: Ulcer and over 3 cm, or vessels invaded: surgery

steps.tx: **FLOT chemotherapy** is fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin and **docetaxel**. It is the standard perioperative treatment for locally advanced resectable gastric and gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Give it before and after surgery, not as a substitute for removing a resectable tumour. It is a cytotoxic regimen, unlike imatinib, which is for GIST. Patients need fitness for four drugs, including docetaxel.
steps.say: FLOT chemotherapy is fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin and docetaxel. It is the perioperative standard for locally advanced resectable gastric and junctional adenocarcinoma. It surrounds an operation. It is not the drug used for GIST.
